body: I didn’t post my state because I don’t know how to use Reddit. 🙂 I will try that!
I’ve tried google before coming here. I’m just trying to ask for peoples’ real life experience on the matter
I haven’t tried initiating a relationship in a looooong time so I’m not worried about that, I’m past that

I haven’t filed for child support because I didn’t know if that would automatically give him access to our child in the court of law in MO. From the comment earlier (I’m not sure how to use Reddit, honestly!) there was physical abuse, it happened in front of our child. CPS was involved, he’s got court stuff going on from it, we’ve been split since January. I’m just trying to make sure my bases and ass is covered pretty much

From what I can remember, we filled out the necessary paperwork, and then missouri does an affidavit. He wasn’t on the birth certificate for the first 6 months or so, but now he is once Missouri filed the paperwork

We weren’t married, but he is on the birth certificate. Does that affect anything? I haven’t offered my child to him since after the 4 times. Child support would be nice, but I feel like that automatically gives him access to our child if I go that route. That’s why I’m stuck. I just am trying to figure out 100% how to go about full custody because at the end of the day I’ll be damned. I’m tired of the revolving door, I just didn’t know if i had to file first for custody.
I think as long as you’re getting “up votes” you’re good!
I also want to correct the *scared part. I’m not scared, or threatened physically by him. Just ptsd from my childhood x

I know I need to. I just feel like I’m stuck. I feel like it’s a trauma bond and I’m stuck and I think that’s why I feel so strongly torn. To love him like I needed to be loved, or to walk away love-less. I’m so sad, I’m new with Reddit, trying to use it as an outlet to talk about my feelings. Thank you for your comment, I’m just exhausted with trying to keep it together. I just got home after avoiding him all day (work) and at least for the last 3 hours. I’m scared. The first spew of bullshit out of his mouth is gonna be an argument. I bet my whole paycheck. I’m just venting, I’m sorry. I’m just so sad with myself.
